title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي، شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْبَيْتَ وَمَعَهُ أُسَامَةُ وَبِلاَلٌ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ فَأَجَافُوا عَلَيْهِمُ الْبَابَ طَوِيلاً ثُمَّ فُتِحَ فَكُنْتُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ دَخَلَ فَلَقِيتُ بِلاَلاً فَقُلْتُ أَيْنَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ بَيْنَ الْعَمُودَيْنِ الْمُقَدَّمَيْنِ ‏.‏ فَنَسِيتُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَهُ كَمْ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم.
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Yahya, al-Qattan, narrated to us. H; Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us. H; and Ibn Numayr narrated to us, and this is his wording. Abdah narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) entered the House with Usamah, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah. They closed the door upon them for a long time, then it was opened. I was the first to enter, and I met Bilal. I asked: Where did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) pray? He said: Between the two front pillars. I forgot to ask him how many units the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had prayed.
translation_de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Yahya, al-Qattan, überlieferte uns. H; Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns. H; and Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns, and this is his wording. Abdah überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) entered the Haus with Usamah, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah. They closed the Tür upon them for a long time, then it was opened. I was the first to enter, and I met Bilal. I asked: Where did der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) pray? Er sagte: Between the two front pillars. I forgot to ask him how many units der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) had betete. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ انْتَهَى إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ وَقَدْ دَخَلَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِلاَلٌ وَأُسَامَةُ وَأَجَافَ عَلَيْهِمْ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ الْبَابَ قَالَ فَمَكَثُوا فِيهِ مَلِيًّا ثُمَّ فُتِحَ الْبَابُ فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَقِيتُ الدَّرَجَةَ فَدَخَلْتُ الْبَيْتَ فَقُلْتُ أَيْنَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالُوا هَا هُنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ وَنَسِيتُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَهُمْ كَمْ صَلَّى.
translation_en: Humayd ibn Masadah narrated to me. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, narrated to us. Abd Allah ibn Awn narrated to us, from Nafi, from Abd Allah ibn Umar. He reached the Ka'bah while the Prophet (peace be upon him), Bilal, and Usamah were inside, and Uthman ibn Talhah had closed the door upon them. They remained there for a while, then the door was opened. The Prophet (peace be upon him) came out, and I climbed the step and entered the House. I asked: Where did the Prophet (peace be upon him) pray? They said: Here. I forgot to ask them how many units he had prayed.
translation_de: Humayd ibn Masadah überlieferte mir. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, überlieferte uns. Abd Allah ibn Awn überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Abd Allah ibn Umar. He reached the Kaaba while der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), Bilal, and Usamah were inside, and Uthman ibn Talhah had closed the Tür upon them. They remained there for a while, then the Tür was opened. The Prophet (peace be upon him) came out, and I climbed the step and entered the Haus. I asked: Where did der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) pray? They said: Here. I forgot to ask them how many units he had betete. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْبَيْتَ هُوَ وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَبِلاَلٌ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ فَأَغْلَقُوا عَلَيْهِمْ فَلَمَّا فَتَحُوا كُنْتُ فِي أَوَّلِ مَنْ وَلَجَ فَلَقِيتُ بِلاَلاً فَسَأَلْتُهُ هَلْ صَلَّى فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ صَلَّى بَيْنَ الْعَمُودَيْنِ الْيَمَانِيَيْنِ.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Layth narrated to us. H; and Ibn Rumh informed us. al-Layth informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, from his father. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) entered the House with Usamah ibn Zayd, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah. They closed it upon them. When they opened it, I was among the first to enter. I met Bilal and asked him whether the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had prayed inside. He said: Yes, he prayed between the two Yemeni pillars.
translation_de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Layth überlieferte uns. H; and Ibn Rumh berichtete uns. al-Layth berichtete uns, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, from his father. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) entered the Haus with Usamah ibn Zayd, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah. They closed it upon them. When they opened it, I was among the first to enter. I met Bilal and asked him whether der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) had betete inside. Er sagte: Yes, he betete between the two Yemeni pillars. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ الْكَعْبَةَ هُوَ وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَبِلاَلٌ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْهَا مَعَهُمْ أَحَدٌ ثُمَّ أُغْلِقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ فَأَخْبَرَنِي بِلاَلٌ أَوْ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى فِي جَوْفِ الْكَعْبَةِ بَيْنَ الْعَمُودَيْنِ الْيَمَانِيَيْنِ.‏
translation_en: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, who informed me that Salim ibn Abd Allah narrated from his father. He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) enter the Ka'bah with Usamah ibn Zayd, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah. No one else entered with them, and the door was closed upon them. Abd Allah ibn Umar said: Bilal or Uthman ibn Talhah informed me that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed inside the Ka'bah between the two Yemeni pillars.
translation_de: Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab, who berichtete mir that Salim ibn Abd Allah narrated from his father. Er sagte: I saw der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) enter the Kaaba with Usamah ibn Zayd, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah. No one else entered with them, and the Tür was closed upon them. Abd Allah ibn Umar said: Bilal or Uthman ibn Talhah berichtete mir that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) betete inside the Kaaba between the two Yemeni pillars. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ بَكْرٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَطَاءٍ أَسَمِعْتَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُمْ بِالطَّوَافِ وَلَمْ تُؤْمَرُوا بِدُخُولِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَنْهَى عَنْ دُخُولِهِ وَلَكِنِّي سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا دَخَلَ الْبَيْتَ دَعَا فِي نَوَاحِيهِ كُلِّهَا وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ فِيهِ حَتَّى خَرَجَ فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ رَكَعَ فِي قُبُلِ الْبَيْتِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ الْقِبْلَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَهُ مَا نَوَاحِيهَا أَفِي زَوَايَاهَا قَالَ بَلْ فِي كُلِّ قِبْلَةٍ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us, both from Ibn Bakr. Abd said: Muhammad ibn Bakr informed us. Ibn Jurayj informed us. He said: I asked Ata: Did you hear Ibn Abbas say, 'You were commanded only to circumambulate, and you were not commanded to enter it'? He said: He did not forbid entering it, but I heard him say: Usamah ibn Zayd informed me that when the Prophet (peace be upon him) entered the House, he supplicated in all its sides and did not pray in it until he came out. When he came out, he prayed two units in front of the House and said: This is the qiblah. I asked: What does 'all its sides' mean, its corners? He said: Rather, every direction facing the House.
translation_de: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte uns, both from Ibn Bakr. Abd said: Muhammad ibn Bakr berichtete uns. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns. Er sagte: I asked Ata: Did you hear Ibn Abbas say, 'You were commanded only to circumambulate, and you were not commanded to enter it'? Er sagte: He did not forbid entering it, but I heard him say: Usamah ibn Zayd berichtete mir that when der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) entered the Haus, he supplicated in all its sides and did not pray in it until he came out. When he came out, he betete two units in front of the Haus and said: This is the qiblah. I asked: What does 'all its sides' mean, its corners? Er sagte: Rather, every direction facing the Haus. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ الْكَعْبَةَ وَفِيهَا سِتُّ سَوَارٍ فَقَامَ عِنْدَ سَارِيَةٍ فَدَعَا وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ ‏.‏
translation_en: Shayban ibn Farrukh narrated to us. Hammam narrated to us. Ata narrated to us, from Ibn Abbas, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) entered the Ka'bah, which had six pillars. He stood beside a pillar and supplicated, but he did not pray.
translation_de: Shayban ibn Farrukh überlieferte uns. Hammam überlieferte uns. Ata überlieferte uns, from Ibn Abbas, that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) entered the Kaaba, which had six pillars. He stood beside a pillar and supplicated, but he did not pray. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ دُخُولِ الْكَعْبَةِ لِلْحَاجِّ وَغَيْرِهِ وَالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي نَوَاحِيهَا كُلِّهَا
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنِي هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى صَاحِبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْبَيْتَ فِي عُمْرَتِهِ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Surayj ibn Yunus narrated to me. Hushaym narrated to me. Ismail ibn Abi Khalid informed us. He said: I asked Abd Allah ibn Abi Awfa, the companion of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him): Did the Prophet (peace be upon him) enter the House during his Umrah? He said: No.
translation_de: Surayj ibn Yunus überlieferte mir. Hushaym überlieferte mir. Ismail ibn Abi Khalid berichtete uns. Er sagte: I asked Abd Allah ibn Abi Awfa, the companion of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm): Did der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) enter the Haus during his Umra? Er sagte: No. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1333 a, book 15, باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
title: باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ حَدَاثَةُ عَهْدِ قَوْمِكِ بِالْكُفْرِ لَنَقَضْتُ الْكَعْبَةَ وَلَجَعَلْتُهَا عَلَى أَسَاسِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَإِنَّ قُرَيْشًا حِينَ بَنَتِ الْبَيْتَ اسْتَقْصَرَتْ وَلَجَعَلْتُ لَهَا خَلْفًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Abu Muawiyah informed us, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to me: If your people were not recent in their disbelief, I would demolish the Ka'bah and rebuild it on the foundation of Ibrahim, for Quraysh made it smaller when they built the House, and I would make a rear door for it.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Abu Muawiyah berichtete uns, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha. Sie sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to me: If your people were not recent in their Unglauben, I would demolish the Kaaba and rebuild it on the foundation of Ibrahim, for Quraysh made it smaller when they built the Haus, and I would make a rear Tür for it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1333 b, book 15, باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
title: باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated it to us. Ibn Numayr narrated to us, from Hisham, with this chain.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated it to us. Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns, from Hisham, with this chain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1333 c, book 15, باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
title: باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ، أَخْبَرَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَمْ تَرَىْ أَنَّ قَوْمَكِ حِينَ بَنَوُا الْكَعْبَةَ اقْتَصَرُوا عَنْ قَوَاعِدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَلاَ تَرُدُّهَا عَلَى قَوَاعِدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ حِدْثَانُ قَوْمِكِ بِالْكُفْرِ لَفَعَلْتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ لَئِنْ كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ سَمِعَتْ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا أُرَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَرَكَ اسْتِلاَمَ الرُّكْنَيْنِ اللَّذَيْنِ يَلِيَانِ الْحِجْرَ إِلاَّ أَنَّ الْبَيْتَ لَمْ يُتَمَّمْ عَلَى قَوَاعِدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim ibn Abd Allah, that Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Siddiq informed Abd Allah ibn Umar, from Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Do you not see that when your people built the Ka'bah, they left out part of the foundations of Ibrahim? She said: I asked: Messenger of Allah, why do you not restore it to the foundations of Ibrahim? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If your people were not recent in disbelief, I would do so. Abd Allah ibn Umar said: If Aisha heard this from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), I do not think he left touching the two corners next to the Hijr except because the House was not completed on the foundations of Ibrahim.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim ibn Abd Allah, that Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Siddiq informed Abd Allah ibn Umar, from Aisha, the wife of der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Do you not see that when your people built the Kaaba, they left out part of the foundations of Ibrahim? Sie sagte: I asked: Messenger of Allah, why do you not restore it to the foundations of Ibrahim? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If your people were not recent in Unglauben, I would do so. Abd Allah ibn Umar said: If Aisha heard this from der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), I do not think he left touching the two corners next to the Hijr except because the Haus was not completed on the foundations of Ibrahim. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1333 d, book 15, باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
title: باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ، بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَخْرَمَةُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ نَافِعًا، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنَّ قَوْمَكِ حَدِيثُو عَهْدٍ بِجَاهِلِيَّةٍ - أَوْ قَالَ بِكُفْرٍ - لأَنْفَقْتُ كَنْزَ الْكَعْبَةِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلَجَعَلْتُ بَابَهَا بِالأَرْضِ وَلأَدْخَلْتُ فِيهَا مِنَ الْحِجْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu al-Tahir narrated to me. Abd Allah ibn Wahb informed us, from Makhramah. H; and Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to me. Ibn Wahb narrated to us. Makhramah ibn Bukayr informed me, from his father. He said: I heard Nafi, the freedman of Ibn Umar, say: I heard Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr ibn Abi Quhafah relate to Abd Allah ibn Umar, from Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), that she said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: If your people were not recent in the pre-Islamic period, or he said disbelief, I would spend the treasure of the Ka'bah in Allah's cause, make its door level with the ground, and include in it what was left out of the Hijr.
translation_de: Abu al-Tahir überlieferte mir. Abd Allah ibn Wahb berichtete uns, from Makhramah. H; and Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb überlieferte uns. Makhramah ibn Bukayr berichtete mir, from his father. Er sagte: I heard Nafi, the freedman of Ibn Umar, say: I heard Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr ibn Abi Quhafah relate to Abd Allah ibn Umar, from Aisha, the wife of der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), that she said: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: If your people were not recent in the pre-Islamic period, or he said Unglauben, I would spend the treasure of the Kaaba in Allah's cause, make its Tür level with the ground, and include in it what was left out of the Hijr. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1333 e, book 15, باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
title: باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مِينَاءَ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَتْنِي خَالَتِي، - يَعْنِي عَائِشَةَ - قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ لَوْلاَ أَنَّ قَوْمَكِ حَدِيثُو عَهْدٍ بِشِرْكٍ لَهَدَمْتُ الْكَعْبَةَ فَأَلْزَقْتُهَا بِالأَرْضِ وَجَعَلْتُ لَهَا بَابَيْنِ بَابًا شَرْقِيًّا وَبَابًا غَرْبِيًّا وَزِدْتُ فِيهَا سِتَّةَ أَذْرُعٍ مِنَ الْحِجْرِ فَإِنَّ قُرَيْشًا اقْتَصَرَتْهَا حَيْثُ بَنَتِ الْكَعْبَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Ibn Mahdi narrated to me. Salim ibn Hayyan narrated to us, from Sa'id, meaning Ibn Mina. He said: I heard Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr say: My aunt, meaning Aisha, narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Aisha, if your people were not recent in shirk, I would demolish the Ka'bah, bring it level with the ground, make two doors for it, an eastern door and a western door, and add six cubits to it from the Hijr, for Quraysh made it smaller when they built the Ka'bah.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Ibn Mahdi überlieferte mir. Salim ibn Hayyan überlieferte uns, from Sa'id, meaning Ibn Mina. Er sagte: I heard Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr say: My aunt, meaning Aisha, überlieferte mir that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Aisha, if your people were not recent in Schirk, I would demolish the Kaaba, bring it level with the ground, make two Türs for it, an eastern Tür and a western Tür, and add six cubits to it from the Hijr, for Quraysh made it smaller when they built the Kaaba. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1333 f, book 15, باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
title: باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا احْتَرَقَ الْبَيْتُ زَمَنَ يَزِيدَ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ حِينَ غَزَاهَا أَهْلُ الشَّامِ فَكَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ مَا كَانَ تَرَكَهُ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ حَتَّى قَدِمَ النَّاسُ الْمَوْسِمَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُجَرِّئَهُمْ - أَوْ يُحَرِّبَهُمْ - عَلَى أَهْلِ الشَّامِ فَلَمَّا صَدَرَ النَّاسُ قَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَشِيرُوا عَلَىَّ فِي الْكَعْبَةِ أَنْقُضُهَا ثُمَّ أَبْنِي بِنَاءَهَا أَوْ أُصْلِحُ مَا وَهَى مِنْهَا قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَإِنِّي قَدْ فُرِقَ لِي رَأْىٌ فِيهَا أَرَى أَنْ تُصْلِحَ مَا وَهَى مِنْهَا وَتَدَعَ بَيْتًا أَسْلَمَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَحْجَارًا أَسْلَمَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهَا وَبُعِثَ عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ لَوْ كَانَ أَحَدُكُمُ احْتَرَقَ بَيْتُهُ مَا رَضِيَ حَتَّى يُجِدَّهُ فَكَيْفَ بَيْتُ رَبِّكُمْ إِنِّي مُسْتَخِيرٌ رَبِّي ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ عَازِمٌ عَلَى أَمْرِي فَلَمَّا مَضَى الثَّلاَثُ أَجْمَعَ رَأْيَهُ عَلَى أَنْ يَنْقُضَهَا فَتَحَامَاهُ النَّاسُ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ بِأَوَّلِ النَّاسِ يَصْعَدُ فِيهِ أَمْرٌ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ حَتَّى صَعِدَهُ رَجُلٌ فَأَلْقَى مِنْهُ حِجَارَةً فَلَمَّا لَمْ يَرَهُ النَّاسُ أَصَابَهُ شَىْءٌ تَتَابَعُوا فَنَقَضُوهُ حَتَّى بَلَغُوا بِهِ الأَرْضَ فَجَعَلَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ أَعْمِدَةً فَسَتَّرَ عَلَيْهَا السُّتُورَ حَتَّى ارْتَفَعَ بِنَاؤُهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ تَقُولُ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنَّ النَّاسَ حَدِيثٌ عَهْدُهُمْ بِكُفْرٍ وَلَيْسَ عِنْدِي مِنَ النَّفَقَةِ مَا يُقَوِّي عَلَى بِنَائِهِ لَكُنْتُ أَدْخَلْتُ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحِجْرِ خَمْسَ أَذْرُعٍ وَلَجَعَلْتُ لَهَا بَابًا يَدْخُلُ النَّاسُ مِنْهُ وَبَابًا يَخْرُجُونَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَنَا الْيَوْمَ أَجِدُ مَا أُنْفِقُ وَلَسْتُ أَخَافُ النَّاسَ - قَالَ - فَزَادَ فِيهِ خَمْسَ أَذْرُعٍ مِنَ الْحِجْرِ حَتَّى أَبْدَى أُسًّا نَظَرَ النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ فَبَنَى عَلَيْهِ الْبِنَاءَ وَكَانَ طُولُ الْكَعْبَةِ ثَمَانِيَ عَشْرَةَ ذِرَاعًا فَلَمَّا زَادَ فِيهِ اسْتَقْصَرَهُ فَزَادَ فِي طُولِهِ عَشَرَ أَذْرُعٍ وَجَعَلَ لَهُ بَابَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا يُدْخَلُ مِنْهُ وَالآخَرُ يُخْرَجُ مِنْهُ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا قُتِلَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ كَتَبَ الْحَجَّاجُ إِلَى عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ يُخْبِرُهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيُخْبِرُهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ قَدْ وَضَعَ الْبِنَاءَ عَلَى أُسٍّ نَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ الْعُدُولُ مِنْ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ ‏.‏ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ إِنَّا لَسْنَا مِنْ تَلْطِيخِ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ فِي شَىْءٍ أَمَّا مَا زَادَ فِي طُولِهِ فَأَقِرَّهُ وَأَمَّا مَا زَادَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحِجْرِ فَرُدَّهُ إِلَى بِنَائِهِ وَسُدَّ الْبَابَ الَّذِي فَتَحَهُ ‏.‏ فَنَقَضَهُ وَأَعَادَهُ إِلَى بِنَائِهِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Hannad ibn al-Sari narrated to us. Ibn Abi Za'idah narrated to us. Ibn Abi Sulayman informed me, from Ata, who said: When the House was burned during the time of Yazid ibn Muawiyah, when the people of Syria attacked it, Ibn al-Zubayr left it until the people came for the season. He wanted to encourage them, or embolden them, against the people of Syria. When the people departed, he said: People, advise me about the Ka'bah. Should I demolish it and rebuild it, or repair what has become weak? Ibn Abbas said: I have formed an opinion about it. I think you should repair what has become weak and leave a House upon which the people entered Islam and stones upon which the people entered Islam, and upon which the Prophet (peace be upon him) was sent. Ibn al-Zubayr said: If one of you had a house that burned, he would not be satisfied until he renewed it, so how can this be the House of your Lord? I will seek my Lord's guidance for three days, then decide. After three days he resolved to demolish it. The people feared that something from heaven would happen to the first person who climbed it, until a man climbed it and threw down a stone. When no harm came to him, they followed him and demolished it to the ground. Ibn al-Zubayr placed pillars and covered them with coverings until the building rose. He said: I heard Aisha say that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: If the people were not recent in disbelief, and I did not have the funds to strengthen its building, I would have included five cubits from the Hijr and made one door for entry and one for exit. I now have what I can spend and do not fear the people. He added five cubits from the Hijr, exposed a foundation that people saw, and built upon it. The Ka'bah had been eighteen cubits long. When he added to it, he found it short and added ten cubits to its length, making two doors, one for entering and one for leaving. After Ibn al-Zubayr was killed, al-Hajjaj wrote to Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan, telling him that Ibn al-Zubayr had built upon a foundation witnessed by trustworthy people of Makkah. Abd al-Malik wrote: Leave what he added to its length, return what he added from the Hijr to its former construction, and close the door he opened. So he demolished it and restored it to its former construction.

Ibn Abi Sulayman berichtete mir, from Ata, who said: When the Haus was burned during the time of Yazid ibn Muawiyah, when the people of Syria attacked it, Ibn al-Zubayr left it until the people came for the season. Ibn al-Zubayr said: If one of you had a house that burned, he would not be satisfied until he renewed it, so how can this be the Haus of your Lord? I will seek my Lord's guidance for drei Tage, then decide. After drei Tage he resolved to demolish it. When no harm came to him, they followed him and demolished it to the ground. Ibn al-Zubayr placed pillars and covered them with coverings until the building rose. Er sagte: I heard Aisha say that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) said: If the people were not recent in Unglauben, and I did not have the funds to strengthen its building, I would have included five cubits from the Hijr and made one Tür for entry and one for exit. I now have what I can spend and do not fear the people. He added five cubits from the Hijr, exposed a foundation that people saw, and built upon it. The Kaaba had been eighteen cubits long. Abd al-Malik wrote: Leave what he added to its length, return what he added from the Hijr to its former construction, and close the Tür he opened. So he demolished it and restored it to its former construction. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1333 g, book 15, باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
title: باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ، اللَّهِ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ وَالْوَلِيدَ بْنَ عَطَاءٍ يُحَدِّثَانِ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ وَفَدَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَى عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ فِي خِلاَفَتِهِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ مَا أَظُنُّ أَبَا خُبَيْبٍ - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ - سَمِعَ مِنْ عَائِشَةَ مَا كَانَ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ مِنْهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ الْحَارِثُ بَلَى أَنَا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ سَمِعْتَهَا تَقُولُ مَاذَا قَالَ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ قَوْمَكِ اسْتَقْصَرُوا مِنْ بُنْيَانِ الْبَيْتِ وَلَوْلاَ حَدَاثَةُ عَهْدِهِمْ بِالشِّرْكِ أَعَدْتُ مَا تَرَكُوا مِنْهُ فَإِنْ بَدَا لِقَوْمِكِ مِنْ بَعْدِي أَنْ يَبْنُوهُ فَهَلُمِّي لأُرِيَكِ مَا تَرَكُوا مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَرَاهَا قَرِيبًا مِنْ سَبْعَةِ أَذْرُعٍ ‏.‏ هَذَا حَدِيثُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ وَزَادَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَلَجَعَلْتُ لَهَا بَابَيْنِ مَوْضُوعَيْنِ فِي الأَرْضِ شَرْقِيًّا وَغَرْبِيًّا وَهَلْ تَدْرِينَ لِمَ كَانَ قَوْمُكِ رَفَعُوا بَابَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَزُّزًا أَنْ لاَ يَدْخُلَهَا إِلاَّ مَنْ أَرَادُوا فَكَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا هُوَ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَهَا يَدْعُونَهُ يَرْتَقِي حَتَّى إِذَا كَادَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ دَفَعُوهُ فَسَقَطَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ لِلْحَارِثِ أَنْتَ سَمِعْتَهَا تَقُولُ هَذَا قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَنَكَتَ سَاعَةً بِعَصَاهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ وَدِدْتُ أَنِّي تَرَكْتُهُ وَمَا تَحَمَّلَ.
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Muhammad ibn Bakr narrated to us. Ibn Jurayj informed us. He said: I heard Abd Allah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr and al-Walid ibn Ata relate from al-Harith ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Rabiah. Abd Allah ibn Ubayd said: Al-Harith came to Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan during his caliphate. Abd al-Malik said: I do not think Abu Khubayb, meaning Ibn al-Zubayr, heard from Aisha what he claimed to have heard. Al-Harith said: Yes, I heard it from her. He asked: What did you hear her say? He said: She said that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Your people made the building of the House smaller. If they had not recently been in shirk, I would restore what they left out. If your people decide after me to rebuild it, come and I will show you what they left out. He showed her nearly seven cubits. Al-Walid added: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: I would make two doors for it, level with the ground, one eastern and one western. Do you know why your people raised its door? She said: No. He said: To control who entered it. When a man wanted to enter, they called him to climb, and when he was about to enter, they pushed him and he fell. Abd al-Malik asked al-Harith: Did you hear her say this? He said: Yes. Abd al-Malik tapped his staff for a while and said: I wish I had left it and what it carried.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Muhammad ibn Bakr überlieferte uns. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns. Er sagte: I heard Abd Allah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr and al-Walid ibn Ata relate from al-Harith ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Rabiah. Abd Allah ibn Ubayd said: Al-Harith came to Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan during his caliphate. Abd al-Malik said: I do not think Abu Khubayb, meaning Ibn al-Zubayr, heard from Aisha what he claimed to have heard. Al-Harith said: Yes, I heard it from her. He asked: What did you hear her say? Er sagte: She said that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Your people made the building of the Haus smaller. If they had not recently been in Schirk, I would restore what they left out. If your people decide after me to rebuild it, come and I will show you what they left out. He showed her nearly seven cubits. Al-Walid added: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: I would make two Türs for it, level with the ground, one eastern and one western. Do you know why your people raised its Tür? Sie sagte: No. Er sagte: To control who entered it. When a man wanted to enter, they called him to climb, and when he was about to enter, they pushed him and he fell. Abd al-Malik asked al-Harith: Did you hear her say this? Er sagte: Yes. Abd al-Malik tapped his staff for a while and said: I wish I had left it and what it carried. title: باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1333 i, book 15, باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
title: باب نَقْضِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبِنَائِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بَكْرٍ السَّهْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ أَبِي، صَغِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي قَزَعَةَ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الْمَلِكِ بْنَ مَرْوَانَ، بَيْنَمَا هُوَ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ إِذْ قَالَ قَاتَلَ اللَّهُ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ حَيْثُ يَكْذِبُ عَلَى أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُهَا تَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ لَوْلاَ حِدْثَانُ قَوْمِكِ بِالْكُفْرِ لَنَقَضْتُ الْبَيْتَ حَتَّى أَزِيدَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحِجْرِ فَإِنَّ قَوْمَكِ قَصَّرُوا فِي الْبِنَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ لاَ تَقُلْ هَذَا يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَأَنَا سَمِعْتُ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ تُحَدِّثُ هَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ لَوْ كُنْتُ سَمِعْتُهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَهْدِمَهُ لَتَرَكْتُهُ عَلَى مَا بَنَى ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Abd Allah ibn Bakr al-Sahmi narrated to us. Hatim ibn Abi Saghirah narrated to us, from Abu Qazaah, that Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan, while circumambulating the House, said: May Allah fight Ibn al-Zubayr, how he lies about the Mother of the Believers, saying that he heard her say that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Aisha, if your people were not recent in disbelief, I would demolish the House and add to it from the Hijr, for your people made the building smaller. Al-Harith ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Rabiah said: Do not say this, Commander of the Believers. I heard the Mother of the Believers relate this. He said: If I had heard it before demolishing it, I would have left it as Ibn al-Zubayr built it.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Abd Allah ibn Bakr al-Sahmi überlieferte uns. Hatim ibn Abi Saghirah überlieferte uns, from Abu Qazaah, that Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan, while circumambulating the Haus, said: May Allah fight Ibn al-Zubayr, how he lies about the Mother of the Believers, saying that he heard her say that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Aisha, if your people were not recent in Unglauben, I would demolish the Haus and add to it from the Hijr, for your people made the building smaller. Al-Harith ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Rabiah said: Do not say this, Commander of the Believers. I heard the Mother of the Believers relate this. Er sagte: If I had heard it before demolishing it, I would have left it as Ibn al-Zubayr built it. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1333 j, book 15, باب جَدْرِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبَابِهَا ‏‏
title: باب جَدْرِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبَابِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَشْعَثُ بْنُ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْجَدْرِ أَمِنَ الْبَيْتِ هُوَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَلِمَ لَمْ يُدْخِلُوهُ فِي الْبَيْتِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ قَوْمَكِ قَصَّرَتْ بِهِمُ النَّفَقَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَمَا شَأْنُ بَابِهِ مُرْتَفِعًا قَالَ ‏"‏ فَعَلَ ذَلِكِ قَوْمُكِ لِيُدْخِلُوا مَنْ شَاءُوا وَيَمْنَعُوا مَنْ شَاءُوا وَلَوْلاَ أَنَّ قَوْمَكِ حَدِيثٌ عَهْدُهُمْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَأَخَافَ أَنْ تُنْكِرَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لَنَظَرْتُ أَنْ أُدْخِلَ الْجَدْرَ فِي الْبَيْتِ وَأَنْ أُلْزِقَ بَابَهُ بِالأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Sa'id ibn Mansur narrated to us. Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us. Ash'ath ibn Abi al-Sha'tha narrated to us, from al-Aswad ibn Yazid, from Aisha. She said: I asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) about the wall: Is it part of the House? He said: Yes. I asked: Why did they not include it in the House? He said: Your people lacked the funds. I asked: Why is its door raised? He said: Your people did that so they could let in whom they wished and prevent whom they wished. If your people were not recent in the pre-Islamic period and I feared their hearts would reject it, I would consider including the wall in the House and bringing its door level with the ground.
translation_de: Sa'id ibn Mansur überlieferte uns. Abu al-Ahwas überlieferte uns. Ash'ath ibn Abi al-Sha'tha überlieferte uns, from al-Aswad ibn Yazid, from Aisha. Sie sagte: I asked der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) about the Mauer: Is it part of the Haus? Er sagte: Yes. I asked: Why did they not include it in the Haus? Er sagte: Your people lacked the funds. I asked: Why is its Tür raised? Er sagte: Your people did that so they could let in whom they wished and prevent whom they wished. If your people were not recent in the pre-Islamic period and I feared their hearts would reject it, I would consider including the Mauer in the Haus and bringing its Tür level with the ground. title: باب جَدْرِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَبَابِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُوسَى - حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْحِجْرِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ وَقَالَ فِيهِ فَقُلْتُ فَمَا شَأْنُ بَابِهِ مُرْتَفِعًا لاَ يُصْعَدُ إِلَيْهِ إِلاَّ بِسُلَّمٍ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ تَنْفِرَ قُلُوبُهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

He gave the hadith with the meaning of the hadith of Abu al-Ahwas and said: I asked why its door was raised and could be reached only by a ladder. He said: For fear that their hearts would recoil.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1334, book 15, باب الْحَجِّ عَنِ الْعَاجِزِ، لِزَمَانَةٍ وَهِرَمٍ وَنَحْوِهِمَا أَوْ لِلْمَوْتِ ‏‏
title: باب الْحَجِّ عَنِ الْعَاجِزِ، لِزَمَانَةٍ وَهِرَمٍ وَنَحْوِهِمَا أَوْ لِلْمَوْتِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ، يَسَارٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ رَدِيفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ خَثْعَمَ تَسْتَفْتِيهِ فَجَعَلَ الْفَضْلُ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهَا وَتَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْرِفُ وَجْهَ الْفَضْلِ إِلَى الشِّقِّ الآخَرِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ فَرِيضَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ فِي الْحَجِّ أَدْرَكَتْ أَبِي شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَثْبُتَ عَلَى الرَّاحِلَةِ أَفَأَحُجُّ عَنْهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَذَلِكَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Abd Allah ibn Abbas, that he said: Al-Fadl ibn Abbas was riding behind the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). A woman from Khath'am came asking him for a ruling, and al-Fadl began looking at her and she at him. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) turned al-Fadl's face toward the other side. She said: Messenger of Allah, Allah's obligation upon His servants concerning Hajj has reached my father as an old man who cannot remain firm on a riding animal. May I perform Hajj on his behalf? He said: Yes. This was during the Farewell Hajj.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Abd Allah ibn Abbas, that he said: Al-Fadl ibn Abbas was riding behind der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). title: باب الْحَجِّ عَنِ الْعَاجِزِ، لِزَمَانَةٍ وَهِرَمٍ وَنَحْوِهِمَا أَوْ لِلْمَوْتِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ الْفَضْلِ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنْ خَثْعَمَ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبِي شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ عَلَيْهِ فَرِيضَةُ اللَّهِ فِي الْحَجِّ وَهُوَ لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَسْتَوِيَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ بَعِيرِهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَحُجِّي عَنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ali ibn Khashram narrated to me. Isa informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Shihab. Sulayman ibn Yasar narrated to us, from Ibn Abbas, from al-Fadl, that a woman from Khath'am said: Messenger of Allah, my father is an old man, and Allah's obligation of Hajj is due from him, but he cannot sit upright on his camel. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Perform Hajj on his behalf.
translation_de: Ali ibn Khashram überlieferte mir. Isa berichtete uns, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Shihab. Sulayman ibn Yasar überlieferte uns, from Ibn Abbas, from al-Fadl, that a woman from Khath'am said: Messenger of Allah, my father is an old man, and Allah's obligation of Hadsch is due from him, but he cannot sit upright on his Kamel. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1336 a, book 15, باب صِحَّةِ حَجِّ الصَّبِيِّ وَأَجْرِ مَنْ حَجَّ بِهِ ‏‏
title: باب صِحَّةِ حَجِّ الصَّبِيِّ وَأَجْرِ مَنْ حَجَّ بِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ، عُيَيْنَةَ - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَقِيَ رَكْبًا بِالرَّوْحَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنِ الْقَوْمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا الْمُسْلِمُونَ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا مَنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ ‏"‏ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَتْ إِلَيْهِ امْرَأَةٌ صَبِيًّا فَقَالَتْ أَلِهَذَا حَجٌّ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ وَلَكِ أَجْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and Ibn Abi Umar all narrated from Ibn Uyaynah. Abu Bakr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Ibrahim ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb, the freedman of Ibn Abbas, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), that he met a caravan at al-Rawha and said: Who are these people? They said: Muslims. They asked: Who are you? He said: The Messenger of Allah. A woman lifted a child to him and said: Is Hajj valid for this one? He said: Yes, and you will have a reward.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and Ibn Abi Umar all narrated from Ibn Uyaynah. Abu Bakr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Ibrahim ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb, the freedman of Ibn Abbas, from Ibn Abbas, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), that he met a caravan at al-Rawha and said: Who are these people? They said: Muslims. They asked: Who are you? Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah. A woman lifted a Kind to him and said: Is Hadsch valid for this one? Er sagte: Yes, and you will have a Belohnung. reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1337, book 15, باب فَرْضِ الْحَجِّ مَرَّةً فِي الْعُمْرِ ‏‏
title: باب فَرْضِ الْحَجِّ مَرَّةً فِي الْعُمْرِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ الْقُرَشِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ الْحَجَّ فَحُجُّوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ أَكُلَّ عَامٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَسَكَتَ حَتَّى قَالَهَا ثَلاَثًا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ لَوَجَبَتْ وَلَمَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ - ثُمَّ قَالَ - ذَرُونِي مَا تَرَكْتُكُمْ فَإِنَّمَا هَلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ بِكَثْرَةِ سُؤَالِهِمْ وَاخْتِلاَفِهِمْ عَلَى أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ فَإِذَا أَمَرْتُكُمْ بِشَىْءٍ فَأْتُوا مِنْهُ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَإِذَا نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ شَىْءٍ فَدَعُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us. al-Rabi ibn Muslim al-Qurashi informed us, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) addressed us and said: People, Allah has made Hajj obligatory upon you, so perform Hajj. A man asked: Every year, Messenger of Allah? He remained silent until the man said it three times. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If I had said yes, it would have become obligatory and you would not have been able to fulfill it. Then he said: Leave me with what I have left for you. Those before you were destroyed by asking too many questions and disagreeing with their prophets. When I command you to do something, do as much of it as you can, and when I forbid you from something, leave it.

text_original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالاَ كَانَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَا نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْهُ فَاجْتَنِبُوهُ وَمَا أَمَرْتُكُمْ بِهِ فَافْعَلُوا مِنْهُ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا أَهْلَكَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ كَثْرَةُ مَسَائِلِهِمْ وَاخْتِلاَفُهُمْ عَلَى أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Harmalah ibn Yahya al-Tujibi narrated to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab. Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman and Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib said: Abu Hurayra used to relate that he heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Whatever I forbid you, avoid it; and whatever I command you, do as much of it as you can. Those before you were destroyed only by their many questions and their disagreement with their prophets.
translation_de: Harmalah ibn Yahya al-Tujibi überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab. Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman and Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib said: Abu Hurayra used to relate that he heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Whatever I forbid you, avoid it; and whatever I command you, do as much of it as you can. Those before you were destroyed only by their many questions and their disagreement with their prophets. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب تَوْقِيرِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَرْكِ إِكْثَارِ سُؤَالِهِ عَمَّا لاَ ضَرُورَةَ إِلَيْهِ أَوْ لاَ يَت
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، - وَهُوَ مَنْصُورُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْخُزَاعِيُّ - أَخْبَرَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf narrated to me. Abu Salamah, Mansur ibn Salamah al-Khuza'i, narrated to us. Layth informed us, from Yazid ibn al-Had, from Ibn Shihab, with this chain, exactly the same.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf überlieferte mir. Abu Salamah, Mansur ibn Salamah al-Khuza'i, überlieferte uns. Layth berichtete uns, from Yazid ibn al-Had, from Ibn Shihab, with this chain, exactly the same. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب تَوْقِيرِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَرْكِ إِكْثَارِ سُؤَالِهِ عَمَّا لاَ ضَرُورَةَ إِلَيْهِ أَوْ لاَ يَت
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ قَالَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ذَرُونِي مَا تَرَكْتُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ هَمَّامٍ ‏"‏ مَا تُرِكْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا هَلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرُوا نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Abu Muawiyah narrated to us. H; and Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Both narrated from al-Amash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayra. H; and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. al-Mughirah, meaning al-Hizami, narrated to us. H; and Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us. Both narrated from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra. H; and Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh narrated it to us. My father narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, who heard Abu Hurayra. H; and Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Ma'mar informed us, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, from Abu Hurayra. All of them said, from the Prophet (peace be upon him): Leave me with what I have left for you. In Hammam's hadith it says: Leave what I have left for you, for those before you were destroyed. Then they mentioned something like the hadith of al-Zuhri from Sa'id and Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayra.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Abu Muawiyah überlieferte uns. H; and Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Both narrated from al-Amash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayra. H; and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. al-Mughirah, meaning al-Hizami, überlieferte uns. H; and Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns. Both narrated from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra. H; and Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh narrated it to us. My father überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, who heard Abu Hurayra. H; and Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte uns. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, from Abu Hurayra. All of them said, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm): Leave me with what I have left for you. In Hammam's hadith it says: Leave what I have left for you, for those before you were destroyed. Then they mentioned something like the hadith of al-Zuhri from Sa'id and Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayra. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1338 a, book 15, باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
title: باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تُسَافِرِ الْمَرْأَةُ ثَلاَثًا إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. They said: Yahya, al-Qattan, narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah. Nafi informed me, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A woman should not travel for three days except with a mahram accompanying her.
translation_de: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. They said: Yahya, al-Qattan, überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah. Nafi berichtete mir, from Ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: A woman should not reisen for drei Tage except with a mahram accompanying her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1338 b, book 15, باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
title: باب سَفَرِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَعَ مَحْرَمٍ إِلَى حَجٍّ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي جَمِيعًا، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ فِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، ‏"‏ ثَلاَثَةً إِلاَّ وَمَعَهَا ذُو مَحْرَمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah narrated to us. H; and Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. All of them narrated from Ubayd Allah, with this chain. Abu Bakr's narration says: more than three. Ibn Numayr's narration from his father says: three, except with a mahram accompanying her.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah überlieferte uns. H; and Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Ubayd Allah, with this chain. Abu Bakr's narration says: more than drei. Ibn Numayr's narration from his father says: drei, except with a mahram accompanying her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.
